design.objective: Maintain project-stage announcements and theme-responsive release-calendar color families within the project boundary.
users: Project members reading and maintaining stage announcements and release-calendar entries.

requirements.statement: Keep project-detail announcement management tab routing.
acceptance: tab=announcements opens the management view without affecting existing tabs.

requirements.statement: Persist project-owned stage announcements with title, rich text and pinning.
Authorize announcement operations server-side for project members.
acceptance: Non-members, cross-tenant calls and invalid stages are rejected.

requirements.statement: Show only announcements for the date-active top-level project stages.
acceptance: Parallel-stage notices are ordered with pinned entries first.
counterexample: Historical or future notices appear as current.

requirements.statement: Render overview announcements safely and responsively.
acceptance: Unsafe markup cannot execute and the required viewports have no page-level horizontal overflow.
counterexample: Raw unsafe HTML or desktop-only layout.

requirements.statement: Store release-calendar theme-internal color-family keys and render them from active global theme tokens.
acceptance: New entries offer five swatch-led internal color families.
Saved entries refresh with the same color-family key.
Both new and historical entries update when global palette or light/dark appearance changes.
counterexample: Selecting ocean or tech-blue as a record color.
Hard-coded date-box colors that do not change with the active theme.

invariants: Server-side membership, tenant, entity, stage, lock and audit controls remain enforced.
No global theme module or published migration is modified.
constraints: Only REQ-083 writable paths may change.
Reuse Vue, Element Plus and active CSS theme variables.
Do not read secrets or access production systems.

selected_approach.name: Stable tone keys backed by active CSS variables
selected_approach.reason: It separates persisted color intent from global theme appearance and avoids duplicate theme definitions.

alternatives.name: Store global palette key
alternatives.rejected_because: It prevents a record from following the current global theme.

alternatives.name: Store fixed CSS colors
alternatives.rejected_because: It cannot respond to theme changes.

inside: ProjectView calendar selector and date-box styling

components.name: ProjectService
components.responsibility: Accept current tone keys and retain legacy read compatibility.

components.name: ProjectView
components.responsibility: Render swatch-led choices and map stored values to active theme variables.

interfaces.name: release-calendar theme_key
interfaces.contract: New writes use tone-1 through tone-5; legacy values are read-compatible and normalize to tone-1 for display.

data_flows.input: A member selects a color family
transitions: Resolve the tone class to a CSS variable
Recalculate through CSS after global theme changes

error_handling.recovery: Choose one of the five supplied color families.

performance: No additional requests or recalculation loops.
compatibility: Keep HTTP path, field name, column and legacy reads.
operations: No Flyway migration or global-style change.

verification_strategy.signal: Allowed values, persistence and theme response are observable.
verification_strategy.method: Focused service test, frontend build, local health and browser checks in two palettes and both appearances.

assumptions.text: The active theme always supplies brand, success, accent, warning and danger variables.
assumptions.basis: Existing global theme stylesheet defines them for every palette and appearance.
assumptions.falsifier: A selectable global theme lacks one of these variables.

decisions.decision: Use tone-1 through tone-5 as stable keys and show them as swatch-led theme-internal color families.
decisions.reason: User rejected global palette and semantic-color selections.

risks.risk: Legacy values may exist from the rejected palette implementation.
risks.impact: An entry could otherwise render without a color.
risks.mitigation: Map every previous key to tone-1 at read/render time and retain server acceptance.

global_constraints: Keep project API paths, theme_key column, authorization and audit behavior unchanged.
Do not edit global CSS/theme modules or migrations.
Restrict writes to the REQ-083 scope.

file_map.responsibility: Validate new tone keys and read legacy keys.
Exercise accepted and rejected theme keys.
Separate new write keys from legacy read keys.
Type create and update requests with new tone keys.
Offer swatches, normalize legacy values and render active-theme date boxes.

tasks.goal: Verify the existing project-stage announcement persistence and tab contract.
input_facts: Existing REQ-083 source already contains project announcement routes, persistence and tab UI.

consumes: Existing project announcement API and tab route
produces: Regression evidence for tab and persisted member CRUD

steps.action: Run focused project service tests that exercise existing announcement CRUD.
steps.expected: Announcement persistence assertions pass without changing the contract.

steps.action: Inspect the existing ProjectView tab route and announcement API types.
steps.expected: The route and API wrapper remain present.

acceptance_checks: The announcement tab contract remains available.
risks: Existing dirty changes may obscure baseline ownership.
tasks.rollback: No source changes are made by this verification task.
stop_conditions: Announcement source is missing or contract behavior regresses.
escalation_conditions: Restoring the feature would require files outside the task scope.

tasks.goal: Verify existing member authorization, stage calculation and overview announcement behavior.
input_facts: Existing ProjectService contains member checks, announcement validation and current-stage lookup.

steps.action: Run focused service authorization and current-stage test cases.
steps.expected: Membership, invalid-stage, optimistic-lock and current-stage assertions pass.

steps.action: Inspect current-stage announcement loading in the project overview.
steps.expected: Overview reads the project-scoped current-stage endpoint.

acceptance_checks: Server membership behavior is not weakened.
Only date-active stages feed the overview.
risks: A local test runtime may have unrelated JDK compatibility failures.
tasks.rollback: No source changes are made by this verification task.
escalation_conditions: A failure indicates a cross-module security regression.

tasks.goal: Verify existing announcement safe rendering and responsive build behavior.
input_facts: ProjectView contains announcement overview and detail rendering; the project uses a Vue production build.

produces: Frontend build and rendering regression evidence

steps.action: Build the existing frontend production bundle.
Perform browser checks at desktop and required mobile viewports when automation is available.
steps.command: Verify project overview and announcement management at 1280x800, 375x812, 390x844 and 430x932.
steps.expected: No page-level horizontal overflow or unsafe announcement rendering.
steps.evidence: Recorded browser observations or an explicit tool limitation.

acceptance_checks: Announcement views compile and preserve responsive constraints.
Unsafe content is not rendered as executable markup.
risks: Browser automation may be unavailable in the local Codex session.
tasks.rollback: No source changes are made by this verification task.
stop_conditions: A browser observation shows executable markup or page overflow.
escalation_conditions: Fix requires a shared editor, router or UI component change.

tasks.goal: Verify the existing overview layout and release-calendar month boundary behavior.
input_facts: ProjectView already contains the three-panel overview and current-year release calendar.

steps.action: Inspect month navigation boundaries and overview calendar classes.
steps.expected: Navigation stays within the current year and date boxes retain tooltips.

steps.action: Build the frontend after the T5 change.
steps.expected: The overview layout continues to compile.

acceptance_checks: Project plan remains on its own overview row.
Release calendar navigation cannot cross the current year.
risks: A visual issue may require browser evidence.
tasks.rollback: No source changes are made by this verification task.
stop_conditions: The overview layout or year boundary behavior regresses.
escalation_conditions: Correction requires a global layout or theme module edit.

tasks.goal: Replace global-palette selection with five active-theme color families while preserving legacy reads.
input_facts: ProjectView currently uses global palette selections
the global stylesheet exposes five variable families

steps.action: Add focused service assertions for five accepted tone keys, legacy values and an invalid key.
steps.expected: The new assertions initially expose missing allowed keys, then pass after the service update.

steps.action: Restrict new write types and API payloads to tone-1 through tone-5 while retaining legacy response typing.
steps.expected: TypeScript compiles without a PaletteKey dependency in project DTOs.

steps.action: Replace maintenance options and date-box class mapping with swatch-led tone classes that only use active CSS variables.
steps.expected: The production bundle compiles and contains no global-palette release-calendar choices.
steps.evidence: Vite build exit code and source inspection.

steps.action: Run focused checks and local user-path verification in light and dark modes across two global palettes.
steps.expected: No whitespace errors; all five tone choices persist and existing boxes change with the theme.
steps.evidence: Command output, health probes and browser observations.

acceptance_checks: Five and only five swatch-led options appear for new or edited records.
A saved tone key refreshes as the selected option.
Switching global palette or appearance changes an existing date box without saving.
Legacy stored keys remain readable and render as tone-1.
risks: A missing theme variable could reduce contrast.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the T5 scoped source changes; retain stored keys and legacy acceptance.
stop_conditions: Implementing the behavior requires editing web/src/styles.css or a theme store.
Any active global palette lacks a required color variable.
escalation_conditions: User requests fixed colors or changes to global theme definitions.

dependency_edges.reason: Authorization and active-stage regression assumes announcement persistence remains intact.
Safe rendering verification consumes the existing announcement UI contract.
Overview rendering verification consumes current-stage loading behavior.
Layout regression is sampled after the overview rendering build passes.

integration_checks.command: mvn -pl :ccb-system -am -Dtest=ProjectServiceTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test; npm --prefix web run build; git diff --check
integration_checks.expected: Focused backend tests, frontend production build and whitespace check pass.

approval.evidence: User reviewed and approved implementation plan revision 4.

plant_boundary_candidates: ProjectService release-calendar validation and ProjectView date-box rendering.

assumptions.text: The active theme variables resolve dynamically after data-palette or data-theme changes.
assumptions.falsifier: Computed date-box colors remain unchanged after a supported theme switch.
